<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Respawn — Gaming Marketplace</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg: #f4f1fa;
            --surface: #ffffff;
            --surface-2: #ede9f7;
            --text: #14101f;
            --text-dim: #5d5470;
            --accent: #8b5cf6;
            --accent-2: #ff6b6b;
            --border: #ddd6eb;
            --shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
            --card-bg: #ffffff;
            --header-bg: rgba(244,241,250,0.85);
            --chip-bg: #ede9f7;
            --chip-active: #8b5cf6;
            --chip-text: #14101f;
            --input-bg: #ffffff;
            --focus-ring: #8b5cf6;
            --skeleton: #e3dcef;
            --heart: #ff6b6b;
            --btn-primary: #14101f;
            --btn-primary-text: #ffffff;
            --btn-secondary: #ede9f7;
            --btn-secondary-text: #14101f;
            --modal-bg: #ffffff;
            --modal-overlay: rgba(20,16,31,0.5);
        }
        [data-theme="dark"] {
            --bg: #0c0a12;
            --surface: #171322;
            --surface-2: #201a30;
            --text: #ede9f7;
            --text-dim: #a89fc2;
            --accent: #a78bfa;
            --accent-2: #ff8585;
            --border: #332b4a;
            --shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            --card-bg: #1a1626;
            --header-bg: rgba(12,10,18,0.85);
            --chip-bg: #251e39;
            --chip-active: #7c3aed;
            --chip-text: #ede9f7;
            --input-bg: #241c38;
            --focus-ring: #a78bfa;
            --skeleton: #2a2140;
            --heart: #ff8585;
            --btn-primary: #ede9f7;
            --btn-primary-text: #14101f;
            --btn-secondary: #2a2140;
            --btn-secondary-text: #ede9f7;
            --modal-bg: #1a1626;
            --modal-overlay: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
        }
        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }
        html {
            font-size: 16px;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }
        body {
            font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg);
            color: var(--text);
            line-height: 1.5;
            transition: background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            * {
                animation: none !important;
                transition: none !important;
                scroll-behavior: auto !important;
            }
        }
        a {
            color: inherit;
            text-decoration: none;
        }
        button {
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: inherit;
            cursor: pointer;
            border: none;
            background: none;
            color: inherit;
        }
        input {
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: inherit;
            border: none;
            outline: none;
            background: none;
            color: inherit;
        }
        img {
            display: block;
            max-width: 100%;
        }
        .skip-link {
            position: absolute;
            left: -9999px;
            top: 0;
            background: var(--accent);
            color: #fff;
            padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
            z-index: 2000;
            border-radius: 0 0 8px 0;
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .skip-link:focus {
            left: 0;
        }
        header {
            position: sticky;
            top: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            background: var(--header-bg);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            transition: background 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
        }
        .header-inner {
            max-width: 1280px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .logo {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
            color: var(--text);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.35rem;
        }
        .logo span {
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        nav {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.25rem;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-left: 1rem;
        }
        nav button {
            padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
        }
        nav button:hover,
        nav button.active {
            background: var(--chip-bg);
            color: var(--text);
        }
        .search-box {
            position: relative;
            margin-left: auto;
            flex: 0 1 260px;
            min-width: 180px;
        }
        .search-box input {
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--input-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem 0.6rem 2.2rem;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--text);
            transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
        }
        .search-box input:focus {
            border-color: var(--focus-ring);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(139,92,246,0.15);
        }
        .search-icon {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0.7rem;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            pointer-events: none;
            font-size: 1rem;
        }
        .header-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            align-items: center;
            margin-left: auto;
        }
        .icon-btn {
            position: relative;
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: var(--text);
            transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
        }
        .icon-btn:hover {
            background: var(--chip-bg);
            border-color: var(--accent);
        }
        .cart-count {
            position: absolute;
            top: -6px;
            right: -6px;
            background: var(--accent-2);
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            min-width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 0 4px;
        }
        .user-chip {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            background: var(--surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text);
            max-width: 160px;
        }
        .user-chip .avatar {
            width: 26px;
            height: 26px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .user-chip .name {
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
        .sign-out-btn {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-decoration: underline;
            padding: 0.2rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .sign-out-btn:hover {
            color: var(--accent-2);
        }
        .login-btn {
            background: var(--btn-primary);
            color: var(--btn-primary-text);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 0.55rem 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .login-btn:hover {
            opacity: 0.9;
        }
        .hero-section {
            max-width: 1280px;
            margin: 2rem auto 1rem;
            padding: 0 1.25rem;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 2rem;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 420px;
        }
        .hero-left {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 1rem;
            align-items: flex-start;
        }
        .hero-kicker {
            background: var(--chip-bg);
            color: var(--accent);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem;
            border-radius: 30px;
        }
        .hero-title {
            font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 3.8rem);
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            line-height: 1.1;
            color: var(--text);
        }
        .hero-title .coral {
            color: var(--accent-2);
        }
        .hero-sub {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            max-width: 480px;
        }
        .hero-cta {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.75rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: 0.5rem;
        }
        .btn-primary {
            background: var(--btn-primary);
            color: var(--btn-primary-text);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 0.8rem 1.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1rem;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
        }
        .btn-primary:hover {
            opacity: 0.9;
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }
        .btn-secondary {
            background: var(--btn-secondary);
            color: var(--btn-secondary-text);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 0.8rem 1.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1rem;
            transition: background 0.2s ease;
        }
        .btn-secondary:hover {
            background: var(--chip-bg);
        }
        .hero-right {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .hero-img {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 520px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            aspect-ratio: 1/1;
            object-fit: cover;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }
        .hero-img:hover {
            transform: scale(1.01);
        }
        .marketplace {
            max-width: 1280px;
            margin: 1.5rem auto 2rem;
            padding: 0 1.25rem;
        }
        .filter-bar {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 0.7rem;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }
        .filter-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.4rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .chip {
            background: var(--chip-bg);
            color: var(--chip-text);
            border-radius: 30px;
            padding: 0.5rem 1.1rem;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            border: 1px solid transparent;
            transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .chip:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent);
        }
        .chip.active {
            background: var(--chip-active);
            color: #fff;
            border-color: var(--chip-active);
        }
        .sort-select {
            margin-left: auto;
            background: var(--input-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--text);
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            outline: none;
        }
        .sort-select:focus {
            border-color: var(--focus-ring);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(139,92,246,0.15);
        }
        .product-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr));
            gap: 1.5rem;
        }
        .product-card {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border-radius: 16px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }
        .product-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            border-color: var(--accent);
        }
        .product-image-wrap {
            position: relative;
            aspect-ratio: 1/1;
            overflow: hidden;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .product-image-wrap img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }
        .product-card:hover .product-image-wrap img {
            transform: scale(1.04);
        }
        .heart-btn {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0.8rem;
            right: 0.8rem;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: #fff;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
            transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
            z-index: 5;
        }
        .heart-btn:hover {
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }
        .heart-btn.saved {
            color: var(--heart);
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
        }
        .product-body {
            padding: 1rem 1.1rem 1.1rem;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.4rem;
            flex: 1;
        }
        .product-category {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .product-name {
            font-size: 1.15rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }
        .product-price {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text);
        }
        .product-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            margin-top: auto;
            padding-top: 0.7rem;
        }
        .add-btn {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--btn-primary);
            color: var(--btn-primary-text);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
        }
        .add-btn:hover {
            opacity: 0.9;
        }
        .empty-state {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 3rem 1rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.8rem;
        }
        .empty-state .emoji {
            font-size: 3rem;
        }
        .collections-section {
            max-width: 1280px;
            margin: 2rem auto;
            padding: 0 1.25rem;
            background: var(--surface);
            border-radius: 24px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 2rem;
        }
        .collections-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }
        .collections-title {
            font-size: 1.6rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        .keyboard-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 1rem;
        }
        .keyboard-card {
            border-radius: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: var(--surface-2);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }
        .keyboard-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }
        .keyboard-card img {
            width: 100%;
            aspect-ratio: 16/10;
            object-fit: cover;
        }
        .keyboard-card .kb-name {
            padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }
        .keyboard-card .kb-tag {
            padding: 0 0.8rem 0.7rem;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        footer {
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: 2rem 1.25rem;
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            max-width: 1280px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        dialog {
            background: var(--modal-bg);
            color: var(--text);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 1.8rem;
            max-width: 480px;
            width: 90%;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            margin: auto;
        }
        dialog::backdrop {
            background: var(--modal-overlay);
            backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
        }
        .modal-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
        }
        .modal-title {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            font-weight: 800;
        }
        .modal-close {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            line-height: 1;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
            border-radius: 6px;
        }
        .modal-close:hover {
            background: var(--chip-bg);
            color: var(--text);
        }
        .cart-items {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.8rem;
            max-height: 50vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }
        .cart-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.8rem;
            align-items: center;
            background: var(--surface-2);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 0.6rem;
        }
        .cart-item img {
            width: 55px;
            height: 55px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            object-fit: cover;
        }
        .cart-item-info {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
        }
        .cart-item-name {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
        .cart-item-price {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .qty-control {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4rem;
        }
        .qty-btn {
            background: var(--chip-bg);
            border-radius: 6px;
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1rem;
        }
        .qty-btn:hover {
            background: var(--accent);
            color: #fff;
        }
        .qty-num {
            font-weight: 700;
            min-width: 24px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .remove-btn {
            color: var(--accent-2);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: underline;
            padding: 0.2rem;
        }
        .remove-btn:hover {
            opacity: 0.7;
        }
        .cart-subtotal {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            padding: 0.8rem 0;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }
        .cart-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.6rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .checkout-btn {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--btn-primary);
            color: var(--btn-primary-text);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
        }
        .checkout-btn:hover {
            opacity: 0.9;
        }
        .clear-btn {
            background: var(--btn-secondary);
            color: var(--btn-secondary-text);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }
        .login-form {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.8rem;
        }
        .login-form input {
            background: var(--input-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;
            font-size: 1rem;
            color: var(--text);
        }
        .login-form input:focus {
            border-color: var(--focus-ring);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(139,92,246,0.15);
        }
        .login-form button {
            align-self: flex-start;
        }
        .demo-note {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-top: 0.4rem;
        }
        .toast {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 2rem;
            right: 2rem;
            background: var(--text);
            color: var(--bg);
            padding: 0.8rem 1.4rem;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            z-index: 1500;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
            transform: translateY(20px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }
        .toast.show {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .hero-section {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
                gap: 1.5rem;
                text-align: center;
            }
            .hero-left {
                align-items: center;
            }
            .hero-sub {
                max-width: 100%;
            }
            .hero-cta {
                justify-content: center;
            }
            .hero-right {
                order: -1;
            }
            .hero-img {
                max-width: 380px;
            }
            .header-inner {
                flex-wrap: wrap;
            }
            .search-box {
                order: 10;
                flex: 1 1 100%;
                margin-left: 0;
            }
            nav {
                order: 11;
                margin-left: 0;
                flex: 1 1 100%;
                justify-content: center;
            }
            .sort-select {
                margin-left: 0;
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .header-inner {
                padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
                gap: 0.5rem;
            }
            .logo {
                font-size: 1.2rem;
            }
            .icon-btn {
                width: 36px;
                height: 36px;
                font-size: 1rem;
            }
            .login-btn {
                padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem;
                font-size: 0.75rem;
            }
            .marketplace, .hero-section, .collections-section {
                padding-left: 0.8rem;
                padding-right: 0.8rem;
            }
            .product-grid {
                gap: 0.8rem;
                grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr));
            }
            .product-body {
                padding: 0.7rem;
            }
            .product-name {
                font-size: 0.95rem;
            }
            .product-price {
                font-size: 0.95rem;
            }
            .add-btn {
                font-size: 0.75rem;
                padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
            }
            .heart-btn {
                width: 30px;
                height: 30px;
                font-size: 0.9rem;
                top: 0.5rem;
                right: 0.5rem;
            }
            .collections-section {
                padding: 1rem;
            }
            .keyboard-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr));
                gap: 0.6rem;
            }
            .modal-close {
                font-size: 1.2rem;
            }
            dialog {
                padding: 1.2rem;
                width: 95%;
            }
            .cart-item img {
                width: 45px;
                height: 45px;
            }
            .cart-item-name {
                font-size: 0.8rem;
            }
            .toast {
                bottom: 1rem;
                right: 1rem;
                font-size: 0.8rem;
                padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <a class="skip-link" href="#main-content">Skip to main content</a>

    <header>
        <div class="header-inner">
            <div class="logo">RESPAWN<span>.</span></div>
            <nav aria-label="Primary navigation">
                <button class="active" data-nav="discover">Discover</button>
                <button data-nav="gear">Gear</button>
                <button data-nav="collections">Collections</button>
            </nav>
            <div class="search-box">
                <span class="search-icon" aria-hidden="true">🔍</span>
                <input type="search" id="searchInput" placeholder="Search gear..." aria-label="Search products">
            </div>
            <div class="header-actions">
                <button class="icon-btn" id="savedBtn" aria-label="Saved items">
                    ♥ <span class="cart-count" id="savedCount">0</span>
                </button>
                <button class="icon-btn" id="themeToggle" aria-label="Toggle theme">🌙</button>
                <button class="icon-btn" id="cartBtn" aria-label="Open cart">
                    🛒 <span class="cart-count" id="cartCount">0</span>
                </button>
                <div id="userArea">
                    <button class="login-btn" id="loginBtn">Demo Login</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </header>

    <main id="main-content">
        <section class="hero-section" aria-label="Hero">
            <div class="hero-left">
                <span class="hero-kicker">Premium Gaming Gear</span>
                <h1 class="hero-title">Good games.<br><span class="coral">Great gear.</span></h1>
                <p class="hero-sub">Level up your setup with Respawn's curated collection of controllers, keyboards, headsets, and mice — built for players who demand more.</p>
                <div class="hero-cta">
                    <button class="btn-primary" id="shopNowBtn">Shop the Drop</button>
                    <button class="btn-secondary" id="exploreCollectionsBtn">Explore Collections</button>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="hero-right">
                <img class="hero-img" src="http://127.0.0.1:5173/marketplace/hero.webp" alt="Cinematic gaming controller with dramatic lighting" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='block';">
                <div style="display:none; width:100%; max-width:520px; aspect-ratio:1/1; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:20px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:4rem;">🎮</div>
            </div>
        </section>

        <section class="marketplace" aria-label="Product marketplace">
            <div class="filter-bar" role="group" aria-label="Category filters">
                <div class="filter-group">
                    <button class="chip active" data-category="all">All Gear</button>
                    <button class="chip" data-category="Controllers">Controllers</button>
                    <button class="chip" data-category="Keyboards">Keyboards</button>
                    <button class="chip" data-category="Headsets">Headsets</button>
                    <button class="chip" data-category="Mice">Mice</button>
                </div>
                <select class="sort-select" id="sortSelect" aria-label="Sort by price">
                    <option value="featured">Sort by: Featured</option>
                    <option value="low-high">Price: Low to High</option>
                    <option value="high-low">Price: High to Low</option>
                </select>
            </div>
            <div class="product-grid" id="productGrid" role="list">
            </div>
            <div class="empty-state" id="emptyState" style="display:none;">
                <span class="emoji">🔍</span>
                <p>No gear matches your search.</p>
                <button class="btn-secondary" id="clearSearch">Clear Search</button>
            </div>
        </section>

        <section class="collections-section" aria-label="Keyboard collections">
            <div class="collections-header">
                <h2 class="collections-title">⌨️ Keyboard Collections</h2>
                <span style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:0.9rem;">Curated by Respawn</span>
            </div>
            <div class="keyboard-grid" id="keyboardGrid">
            </div>
        </section>
    </main>

    <footer>
        <p>© 2025 Respawn — Demo marketplace for gamers. All products are fictional. No real payments processed.</p>
    </footer>

    <!-- Cart Modal -->
    <dialog id="cartModal" aria-labelledby="cartModalTitle">
        <div class="modal-header">
            <h2 class="modal-title" id="cartModalTitle">Your Cart</h2>
            <button class="modal-close" id="closeCartModal" aria-label="Close cart">✕</button>
        </div>
        <div class="cart-items" id="cartItemsList"></div>
        <div class="cart-subtotal">Subtotal <span id="cartSubtotal">$0</span></div>
        <div class="cart-actions">
            <button class="checkout-btn" id="checkoutBtn">Checkout (Demo)</button>
            <button class="clear-btn" id="clearCartBtn">Clear Cart</button>
        </div>
        <p class="demo-note" style="margin-top:0.8rem;">Demo checkout — no payment will be taken.</p>
    </dialog>

    <!-- Saved Modal -->
    <dialog id="savedModal" aria-labelledby="savedModalTitle">
        <div class="modal-header">
            <h2 class="modal-title" id="savedModalTitle">Saved Items</h2>
            <button class="modal-close" id="closeSavedModal" aria-label="Close saved">✕</button>
        </div>
        <div class="cart-items" id="savedItemsList"></div>
    </dialog>

    <!-- Login Modal -->
    <dialog id="loginModal" aria-labelledby="loginModalTitle">
        <div class="modal-header">
            <h2 class="modal-title" id="loginModalTitle">Demo Login</h2>
            <button class="modal-close" id="closeLoginModal" aria-label="Close login">✕</button>
        </div>
        <div class="login-form">
            <label for="displayName">Display Name</label>
            <input type="text" id="displayName" placeholder="e.g. NovaGamer" autocomplete="off">
            <button class="btn-primary" id="submitLoginBtn">Enter Marketplace</button>
            <p class="demo-note">Demo only — no password or real account needed.</p>
        </div>
    </dialog>

    <!-- Checkout Confirmation Modal -->
    <dialog id="checkoutModal" aria-labelledby="checkoutModalTitle">
        <div class="modal-header">
            <h2 class="modal-title" id="checkoutModalTitle">Confirm Demo Order</h2>
            <button class="modal-close" id="closeCheckoutModal" aria-label="Close checkout">✕</button>
        </div>
        <p style="margin-bottom:1rem;">Your demo order total is <strong id="checkoutTotal">$0</strong>.</p>
        <p class="demo-note" style="margin-bottom:1.2rem;">This is a demo checkout. No payment will be taken, and no items will actually ship.</p>
        <div class="cart-actions">
            <button class="checkout-btn" id="confirmCheckoutBtn">Confirm Demo Order</button>
            <button class="clear-btn" id="cancelCheckoutBtn">Cancel</button>
        </div>
    </dialog>

    <div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

    <script>
        (function() {
            const PRODUCTS = [
                {
                    id: 'controller',
                    name: 'Phantom Wireless Controller',
                    price: 89,
                    category: 'Controllers',
                    image: 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/marketplace/controller.webp',
                    desc: 'Low-latency wireless precision control.'
                },
                {
                    id: 'keyboard',
                    name: 'Nova 75 Mechanical Keyboard',
                    price: 129,
                    category: 'Keyboards',
                    image: 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/marketplace/keyboard.webp',
                    desc: 'Hot-swappable, gasket-mounted, RGB-ready.'
                },
                {
                    id: 'headset',
                    name: 'Eclipse Spatial Headset',
                    price: 109,
                    category: 'Headsets',
                    image: 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/marketplace/headset.webp',
                    desc: 'Immersive spatial audio with noise cancelling.'
                },
                {
                    id: 'mouse',
                    name: 'Drift Ultralight Mouse',
                    price: 59,
                    category: 'Mice',
                    image: 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/marketplace/mouse.webp',
                    desc: '48g ultra-light, pro-grade sensor.'
                }
            ];

            let state = {
                cart: [], // {productId, qty}
                saved: [], // productIds
                search: '',
                category: 'all',
                sort: 'featured',
                theme: 'light',
                user: null,
            };

            const themeToggle = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
            const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
            const productGrid = document.getElementById('productGrid');
            const emptyState = document.getElementById('emptyState');
            const cartModal = document.getElementById('cartModal');
            const savedModal = document.getElementById('savedModal');
            const loginModal = document.getElementById('loginModal');
            const checkoutModal = document.getElementById('checkoutModal');
            const cartBtn = document.getElementById('cartBtn');
            const savedBtn = document.getElementById('savedBtn');
            const loginBtn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');
            const userArea = document.getElementById('userArea');
            const cartCount = document.getElementById('cartCount');
            const savedCount = document.getElementById('savedCount');
            const cartItemsList = document.getElementById('cartItemsList');
            const savedItemsList = document.getElementById('savedItemsList');
            const cartSubtotal = document.getElementById('cartSubtotal');
            const checkoutTotal = document.getElementById('checkoutTotal');
            const clearSearchBtn = document.getElementById('clearSearch');
            const shopNowBtn = document.getElementById('shopNowBtn');
            const exploreCollectionsBtn = document.getElementById('exploreCollectionsBtn');
            const sortSelect = document.getElementById('sortSelect');
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast');

            function showToast(msg) {
                toast.textContent = msg;
                toast.classList.add('show');
                clearTimeout(toast._timeout);
                toast._timeout = setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 2000);
            }

            function getCartItem(productId) {
                return state.cart.find(item => item.productId === productId);
            }

            function addToCart(productId) {
                const existing = getCartItem(productId);
                if (existing) {
                    existing.qty += 1;
                } else {
                    state.cart.push({ productId, qty: 1 });
                }
                updateCartUI();
                showToast('Added to cart');
            }

            function removeFromCart(productId) {
                state.cart = state.cart.filter(item => item.productId !== productId);
                updateCartUI();
            }

            function changeQty(productId, delta) {
                const item = getCartItem(productId);
                if (!item) return;
                item.qty += delta;
                if (item.qty <= 0) {
                    removeFromCart(productId);
                } else {
                    updateCartUI();
                }
            }

            function toggleSaved(productId) {
                if (state.saved.includes(productId)) {
                    state.saved = state.saved.filter(id => id !== productId);
                    showToast('Removed from saved');
                } else {
                    state.saved.push(productId);
                    showToast('Saved to collection');
                }
                updateSavedUI();
                renderProducts();
            }

            function getFilteredProducts() {
                let filtered = PRODUCTS.filter(p => {
                    const matchesSearch = p.name.toLowerCase().includes(state.search.toLowerCase()) ||
                        p.category.toLowerCase().includes(state.search.toLowerCase());
                    const matchesCategory = state.category === 'all' || p.category === state.category;
                    return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
                });
                if (state.sort === 'low-high') {
                    filtered.sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price);
                } else if (state.sort === 'high-low') {
                    filtered.sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price);
                }
                return filtered;
            }

            function renderProducts() {
                const filtered = getFilteredProducts();
                productGrid.innerHTML = '';
                emptyState.style.display = filtered.length === 0 ? 'flex' : 'none';
                productGrid.style.display = filtered.length === 0 ? 'none' : 'grid';
                if (filtered.length === 0) return;

                filtered.forEach(product => {
                    const card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'product-card';
                    card.setAttribute('role', 'listitem');
                    card.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="product-image-wrap" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="${product.name} — view details">
                            <img src="${product.image}" alt="${product.name}" loading="lazy" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.parentElement.innerHTML='<div style="width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:3rem;background:var(--surface-2);">🎮</div>'">
                            <button class="heart-btn ${state.saved.includes(product.id) ? 'saved' : ''}" data-save="${product.id}" aria-label="Save ${product.name}" aria-pressed="${state.saved.includes(product.id)}">${state.saved.includes(product.id) ? '♥' : '♡'}</button>
                        </div>
                        <div class="product-body">
                            <span class="product-category">${product.category}</span>
                            <h3 class="product-name">${product.name}</h3>
                            <span class="product-price">$${product.price}</span>
                            <div class="product-actions">
                                <button class="add-btn" data-add="${product.id}">Add to Cart</button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    card.querySelector('[data-add]').addEventListener('click', () => addToCart(product.id));
                    card.querySelector('[data-save]').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        toggleSaved(product.id);
                    });
                    card.querySelector('.product-image-wrap').addEventListener('click', () => showToast(`${product.name} — $${product.price}`));
                    productGrid.appendChild(card);
                });
            }

            function renderKeyboardCollections() {
                const kbGrid = document.getElementById('keyboardGrid');
                kbGrid.innerHTML = '';
                const keyboards = [
                    { name: 'Nova 75 — Phantom Black', tag: 'Gasket mounted · RGB', img: 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/marketplace/keyboard.webp' },
                    { name: 'Nova 75 — Lavender Mist', tag: 'Tactile switches · PBT caps', img: 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/marketplace/keyboard.webp' },
                    { name: 'Nova 75 — Coral Sunrise', tag: 'Linear · 65g · Silicone dampened', img: 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/marketplace/keyboard.webp' },
                    { name: 'Nova 75 — Midnight Aurora', tag: 'Hot-swap · South-facing LED', img: 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/marketplace/keyboard.webp' },
                ];
                keyboards.forEach(kb => {
                    const card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'keyboard-card';
                    card.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                    card.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                    card.setAttribute('aria-label', `${kb.name} — ${kb.tag}`);
                    card.innerHTML = `
                        <img src="${kb.img}" alt="${kb.name}" loading="lazy" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.parentElement.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin','<div style="width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/10;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2rem;background:var(--surface-2);">⌨️</div>')">
                        <div class="kb-name">${kb.name}</div>
                        <div class="kb-tag">${kb.tag}</div>
                    `;
                    card.addEventListener('click', () => showToast(`${kb.name} — ${kb.tag}`));
                    kbGrid.appendChild(card);
                });
            }

            function updateCartUI() {
                const totalQty = state.cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.qty, 0);
                cartCount.textContent = totalQty;
                renderCartModal();
            }

            function updateSavedUI() {
                savedCount.textContent = state.saved.length;
                renderSavedModal();
            }

            function renderCartModal() {
                cartItemsList.innerHTML = '';
                if (state.cart.length === 0) {
                    cartItemsList.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state" style="grid-column:1/-1;padding:2rem;"><span class="emoji">🛒</span><p>Your cart is empty.</p></div>';
                    cartSubtotal.textContent = '$0';
                    return;
                }
                let total = 0;
                state.cart.forEach(item => {
                    const product = PRODUCTS.find(p => p.id === item.productId);
                    if (!product) return;
                    const lineTotal = product.price * item.qty;
                    total += lineTotal;
                    const row = document.createElement('div');
                    row.className = 'cart-item';
                    row.innerHTML = `
                        <img src="${product.image}" alt="${product.name}" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
                        <div class="cart-item-info">
                            <div class="cart-item-name">${product.name}</div>
                            <div class="cart-item-price">$${product.price} each</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="qty-control">
                            <button class="qty-btn" data-qty-dec="${product.id}" aria-label="Decrease quantity">−</button>
                            <span class="qty-num">${item.qty}</span>
                            <button class="qty-btn" data-qty-inc="${product.id}" aria-label="Increase quantity">+</button>
                        </div>
                        <button class="remove-btn" data-remove="${product.id}">Remove</button>
                    `;
                    row.querySelector('[data-qty-dec]').addEventListener('click', () => changeQty(product.id, -1));
                    row.querySelector('[data-qty-inc]').addEventListener('click', () => changeQty(product.id, 1));
                    row.querySelector('[data-remove]').addEventListener('click', () => removeFromCart(product.id));
                    cartItemsList.appendChild(row);
                });
                cartSubtotal.textContent = `$${total}`;
                checkoutTotal.textContent = `$${total}`;
            }

            function renderSavedModal() {
                savedItemsList.innerHTML = '';
                if (state.saved.length === 0) {
                    savedItemsList.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state" style="grid-column:1/-1;padding:2rem;"><span class="emoji">♥</span><p>No saved items yet.</p></div>';
                    return;
                }
                state.saved.forEach(id => {
                    const product = PRODUCTS.find(p => p.id === id);
                    if (!product) return;
                    const row = document.createElement('div');
                    row.className = 'cart-item';
                    row.innerHTML = `
                        <img src="${product.image}" alt="${product.name}" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
                        <div class="cart-item-info">
                            <div class="cart-item-name">${product.name}</div>
                            <div class="cart-item-price">$${product.price} · ${product.category}</div>
                        </div>
                        <button class="remove-btn" data-unsave="${product.id}">Remove</button>
                    `;
                    row.querySelector('[data-unsave]').addEventListener('click', () => toggleSaved(product.id));
                    savedItemsList.appendChild(row);
                });
            }

            function updateUserUI() {
                if (state.user) {
                    userArea.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="user-chip">
                            <span class="avatar">${state.user.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}</span>
                            <span class="name">${state.user}</span>
                            <button class="sign-out-btn" id="signOutBtn">Sign out</button>
                        </div>
                    `;
                    document.getElementById('signOutBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                        state.user = null;
                        updateUserUI();
                        showToast('Signed out');
                    });
                } else {
                    userArea.innerHTML = '<button class="login-btn" id="loginBtn">Demo Login</button>';
                    document.getElementById('loginBtn').addEventListener('click', () => loginModal.showModal());
                }
            }

            function applyTheme() {
                document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', state.theme);
                themeToggle.textContent = state.theme === 'light' ? '🌙' : '☀️';
            }

            // Event listeners
            searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                state.search = e.target.value;
                renderProducts();
            });

            clearSearchBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                searchInput.value = '';
                state.search = '';
                renderProducts();
                searchInput.focus();
            });

            sortSelect.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
                state.sort = e.target.value;
                renderProducts();
            });

            document.querySelectorAll('[data-category]').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    document.querySelectorAll('[data-category]').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                    btn.classList.add('active');
                    state.category = btn.dataset.category;
                    renderProducts();
                });
            });

            document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav]').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav]').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                    btn.classList.add('active');
                    const target = btn.dataset.nav;
                    if (target === 'discover') document.querySelector('.marketplace').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                    if (target === 'gear') document.querySelector('.marketplace').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                    if (target === 'collections') document.querySelector('.collections-section').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                });
            });

            shopNowBtn.addEventListener('click', () => document.querySelector('.marketplace').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }));
            exploreCollectionsBtn.addEventListener('click', () => document.querySelector('.collections-section').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }));

            cartBtn.addEventListener('click', () => cartModal.showModal());
            savedBtn.addEventListener('click', () => savedModal.showModal());
            themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
                state.theme = state.theme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
                applyTheme();
            });

            document.getElementById('closeCartModal').addEventListener('click', () => cartModal.close());
            document.getElementById('closeSavedModal').addEventListener('click', () => savedModal.close());
            document.getElementById('closeLoginModal').addEventListener('click', () => loginModal.close());
            document.getElementById('closeCheckoutModal').addEventListener('click', () => checkoutModal.close());

            document.getElementById('clearCartBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                state.cart = [];
                updateCartUI();
                showToast('Cart cleared');
            });

            document.getElementById('checkoutBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (state.cart.length === 0) {
                    showToast('Cart is empty');
                    return;
                }
                cartModal.close();
                checkoutModal.showModal();
            });

            document.getElementById('confirmCheckoutBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                checkoutModal.close();
                state.cart = [];
                updateCartUI();
                showToast('Demo order placed — no payment taken');
            });

            document.getElementById('cancelCheckoutBtn').addEventListener('click', () => checkoutModal.close());

            document.getElementById('submitLoginBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                const name = document.getElementById('displayName').value.trim();
                if (!name) {
                    showToast('Please enter a display name');
                    return;
                }
                state.user = name;
                document.getElementById('displayName').value = '';
                loginModal.close();
                updateUserUI();
                showToast(`Welcome, ${name}!`);
            });

            document.getElementById('displayName').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') document.getElementById('submitLoginBtn').click();
            });

            // Focus handling for dialogs
            [cartModal, savedModal, loginModal, checkoutModal].forEach(dialog => {
                dialog.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    if (e.target === dialog) dialog.close();
                });
            });

            // Initial render
            function init() {
                applyTheme();
                renderProducts();
                renderKeyboardCollections();
                updateCartUI();
                updateSavedUI();
                updateUserUI();
                // Set initial nav active
                document.querySelector('[data-nav="discover"]').classList.add('active');
            }

            init();
        })();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
